question_text: How many events on 2025-12-08 (UTC) had a detection confidence below 0.85?
answer_text: There were 231 events on 2025-12-08 (UTC) with a detection confidence below 0.85.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event) 
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' 
    AND e.confidence < 0.85
  RETURN count(e) AS n
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour) 
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
    AND ch.avg_hc < 0.85
  RETURN sum(ch.event_count) AS n
}
RETURN sum(n) AS total_events_below_confidence
